method: Ten independent fresh read-only contexts, parallel batches up to three; Phase A canonical tree unchanged.

Nine focused safety/actuator checks; independent cold-screen and divider-fault arithmetic; primary MOSFET, MCU and switch sources.
Native model extraction; four fresh nonlinear extrema; independent pack/fire arithmetic and pulse rise; exact output loops and thermal vias.
225 PCB/XML identities, 82 BOM codes / 215 references, 203 pad reconstructions plus 12 placement-only checks; all 82 supplier MPNs at 22:03 UTC.
All 100 pins and 25 AF assignments against DS12110 Rev11; AN2606 Rev70 Table135; primary RM0433/H743 header; reset, back-feed and ESD.
Fit, plate at 280.9224 Hz / 45.4796 g, seven native rules, 215 model boxes, independent nut-stack arithmetic.
Native planes, references and returns; three isolated and combined counterfactual DRC checks; hop and old-Minor remeasurement; public AVA photos.
Five-output manifest, orientation, paste, silk, rules/required fitting; 182 native texts and 215 models; process sources and rendered views.
Actual-board legend/width mutations; empty-rule CLI probe; 59 route tests plus 11 scope/real-board tests; source-bridge width faults.
Four binding hashes, 100 pins, 74 explicit parts, 225 components / 700 pins, 22 contract faults, in-memory binding regeneration, EXTI, timing and HSE clipping.
